title: 第556章 掘地三尺第555章 金龙湾
content_zh:
“钱金龙？就是那个号称钱能通天的疯子？”罗素云脸上充满不屑，这让钱快来原本的好心情全部消失，下一秒一抹凶狠从他的脸上涌出，他整个人贴在铁围栏上对着罗素云喊道：“我不允许你这么说我们老大！你们这些外人根本就不知道他有多厉害！”
罗素云摇了摇头叹了口气再次低下头，钱快来见罗素云不再言语气势也收敛起来，他再次坐在木凳上盯着牢笼里的两女一言不发。
醉花楼外，杨修和吴天昊来到门前，两个迎客女子见状立刻上前招呼道：“呦～这两位客官一看不就是一般人，要不要来楼里吃吃酒听听曲啊？”
话落两人便想上手将杨修两人拉进去，但她们的手还没接触到吴天昊的衣服，便倒在了地上。
“哎呦～客官好狠的心啊！打的奴家好疼～”
“是呀！是呀！姐姐！我也很痛，但是我就喜欢这样的男人，这样才能看出男子气概嘛！”
两名女子被打倒在地根本不敢发火，因为吴天昊的衣服实在是太名贵了，再加上他身上散发出的压迫感，让两人明白面前的人肯定大有来头。
“我们不是来吃酒的！我们是来找你们老板的，识相点就赶紧将他叫出来！”吴天昊没有犹豫立刻喊出，两名女子闻言赶紧从地上起身，他们想进门请示老鸨，但刚转身便看到醉花楼的老鸨扭着腰从醉花楼里走了出来。
“是谁要见我们老板啊！”醉花楼老鸨笑声十分清脆，但当她目光看向吴天昊的时候，灿烂无比的笑容直接凝固在脸上，取而代之的是非常尴尬的笑容表情，不止如此杨修还在她眼里看出了一丝淡淡的恐惧感，“这不是吴宗主嘛！什么风把你给吹来了！”
吴天昊一挥手说道：“不要说那么多！把钱快来给我叫出来，我有事情找他！”
醉花楼老鸨闻言一愣，随后脸上笑容再次活跃起来：“哎呀！您这是找钱老板找到我这里了吧！我跟您说您来的真不巧，钱老板昨天确实来醉花楼吃酒了，但他今天也确实没来！”
吴天昊闻言双眼眯了起来，他深呼吸一口气表情严肃的说道：“你这话糊弄别人也就罢了，能糊弄得到我？我告诉你，如果今天钱快来不出来，那明天醉花楼就准备从乾元剑宗搬家吧！”
醉花楼老鸨闻言身子已经不自觉颤抖起来，她在吴天昊身上感受到强大的压迫感，杨修以为她要实话实说，但最终醉花楼老鸨还是一咬嘴唇开口道：“吴……吴宗主！我不知道您什么意思？这乾元剑宗谁不知道醉花楼是我的产业，和您口中的钱快来搭不上半点关系！您是不是搞错了？”
吴天昊已经没有耐心跟醉花楼老鸨耗下去，他上前一步来到醉花楼老鸨身前
没有犹豫伸手直接掐住她的脖子将她整个人从地上拎了起来。
“我在问你最后一遍，钱快来在哪里？如果再不如实回答你就死在这里吧！”吴天昊声音很大，原本只是路过醉花楼的百姓，也在因为他的话语停下来围观。
“不是吧？这醉花楼的老板不是那老鸨嘛！我怎么听这个中年人的话，这醉花楼的老板是钱快来钱老板？”
“谁知道呢？这中年人这么嚣张，不怕醉花楼养的那些打手吗？”
“怕打手？你知道你口中的中年人是谁吗？”
“是谁啊？”

“是谁啊？”
“这人是乾元剑宗的吴宗主！整个秘境都是属于乾元剑宗的，一个小小的醉花楼怎么能违抗他的命令呢！”
“喔？那这么说，吴宗主说的话是真的喽？这醉花楼的幕后老板真的是钱老板？”
“我看十有八九是这样的！”
杨修能清晰听清人群中的议论，不仅如此杨修还听到醉花楼内传来密集的脚步声，果不其然下一秒二三十个壮硕的汉子，手拿黑色长棍从醉花楼内走了出来，最前面的壮硕汉子看到吴天昊抓着老鸨的脖子直接厉声大喊道：“你是什么人？放开我们老板！”
吴天昊听到这汉子的话，想直接捏碎醉花楼老鸨的脖子，但下一秒一个手按住了他的手腕，吴天昊有些惊讶，也有些生气，但当他转头看向身侧的人时，内心的火气全部消失不见了。
“吴宗主没必要这样！这里人太多了，你要是当着这么多人的面杀了这老鸨，恐怕会给普通百姓留下凶狠的形象！”杨修缓缓开口说道。
吴天昊闻言立刻松开手，他双手抱拳对着杨修行礼说道：“杨兄弟说的是，我刚刚确实是太着急了！”
杨修摆摆手目光看向醉花楼老鸨，重获生息的醉花楼老鸨此刻正跪坐在地上捂着脖子大口呼吸着，杨修没有着急只是等她调整呼吸。
大概过了八秒，醉花楼老鸨缓了过来，她颤抖着从地上起身，目光看向杨修，让她没想到，她只是看了杨修一眼，内心中便涌出来自灵魂深处的恐惧，就仿佛站在她面前的不是一个少年人，而是来自地狱的阎罗。
“你看着我！告诉我钱快来在不在这里？”杨修脸上是一个人畜无害的笑容，但醉花楼老鸨仅仅看了一眼便低下头，她颤抖着声音说道：“不……不在！”
“倒是衷心！”杨修淡淡吐出四个字，随后他转头看向身后的人群说道，“等会儿可能声音有点大！你们最好捂住耳朵！”
或许是因为吴天昊的态度，身后的百姓竟然下意识的全部捂住耳朵。
“钱快来！我只给你一刻钟的时间出来！不然我将你醉花楼拆了，掘地三尺也要找到你！”这几句话杨修动用了灵力，他之所以这么确定钱快来在这里是因为他在地下感受到罗素云和夏清幽的气息，刚刚的掘地三尺就是说给钱快来和夏清幽两人听的。
醉花楼地下，罗素云和夏清幽听到杨修的话同时抬起了头，两人眼中全是光芒，而在两人面前的钱快来，则是面色铁青，因为杨修刚刚说的掘地三尺，他能百分百确定是说给他听的。
content_en:
"Qian Jinlong? Is that the lunatic who claims that money can reach the sky?" Russell Yun's face was full of disdain, which made Qian Kuilai's original good mood disappear. The next second, a fierce look poured out of his face. He leaned against the iron fence and shouted at Russell Yun: "I don't allow you to say that about our boss! You outsiders have no idea how powerful he is!"
Russell Yun shook his head, sighed and lowered his head again. When Qian Kuilai saw that Russell Yun stopped talking and his aura calmed down, he sat on the wooden bench again and stared at the two women in the cage without saying a word.
Outside Zuihua Building, Yang Xiu and Wu Tianhao came to the door. When the two welcoming women saw this, they immediately stepped forward and greeted: "Hey~ These two guests look like ordinary people at first glance. Do you want to come to the building to eat, drink, and listen to music?"
After saying this, the two of them wanted to pull Yang Xiu and the two in, but before their hands came into contact with Wu Tianhao's clothes, they fell to the ground.
"Ouch~ The guest officer is so cruel! It hurts so much when you hit me~"
"Yes! Yes! Sister! It hurts me too, but I just like men like this, so that I can see my masculinity!"
The two women were knocked to the ground and they didn't dare to get angry because Wu Tianhao's clothes were too expensive. Coupled with the oppressive feeling emanating from his body, they knew that the person in front of them must have a lot of background.
"We're not here to have a drink! We're here to see your boss. If you know the truth, call him out immediately!" Wu Tianhao shouted immediately without hesitation. After hearing this, the two women quickly got up from the ground. They wanted to go in and ask the madam for instructions, but as soon as they turned around, they saw the madam from Zuihua Tower twisting her waist and walking out of Zuihua Tower.
"Who wants to see our boss!" The madam of Zuihualou laughed very loudly, but when she looked at Wu Tianhao, the bright smile froze directly on her face, replaced by a very embarrassing smile. Not only that, Yang Xiu also saw a faint sense of fear in her eyes, "Isn't this Master Wu! What kind of wind blew you here!"
Wu Tianhao waved his hand and said, "Don't talk so much! Come and call me the money, I'll come to him if I have something to do!"
The Madam of Zuihualou was stunned when he heard this, and then the smile on his face became lively again: "Oh! You must have found me here because the boss is looking for money! Let me tell you, it is a bad luck for you to come. Boss Qian did come to Zuihualou for a drink yesterday, but he did not come today!"
Wu Tianhao's eyes narrowed when he heard this. He took a deep breath and said with a serious expression: "You are just trying to fool others with your words, but can you fool me? Let me tell you, if the money doesn't come out today, Zuihualou will prepare to move from Qianyuan Sword Sect tomorrow!"
The Madam of Zuihualou trembled unconsciously after hearing this. She felt a strong sense of oppression on Wu Tianhao. Yang Xiu thought she was going to tell the truth, but in the end the Madam of Zuihualou bit her lip and said, "Wu... Sect Master Wu! I don't know what you mean? Who in the Qianyuan Sword Sect doesn't know that Zuihualou is my property, and it has nothing to do with the money you say is coming soon! Are you mistaken?"
Wu Tianhao no longer had the patience to waste time with the Madam of Zuihualou. He took a step forward and came to the Madam of Zuihualou.
Without hesitation, he reached out and grabbed her neck and lifted her up from the ground.
"I'm asking you for the last time, where is the money? If you don't answer truthfully, you will die here!" Wu Tianhao's voice was loud, and the people who were just passing by Zuihua Tower also stopped to watch because of his words.
"Isn't it right? Isn't the boss of Zuihua House that old bustard? Why should I listen to this middle-aged man? The boss of Zuihua House is the boss of Qian Kuai Lai Qian?"
"Who knows? This middle-aged man is so arrogant, isn't he afraid of the thugs raised by Zuihua Tower?"
"Afraid of thugs? Do you know who the middle-aged man you are talking about is?"
"Who is it?"
"Who is it?"
"This man is Sect Leader Wu of the Qianyuan Sword Sect! The whole secretThe realm belongs to the Qianyuan Sword Sect, how can a small Zuihualou disobey his orders! "
"oh? So, is what Sect Leader Wu said true? Is the boss behind Zuihualou really Boss Qian? "
“I think it’s like this nine times out of ten! "
Yang Xiu could clearly hear the discussion in the crowd. Not only that, Yang Xiu also heard the sound of dense footsteps coming from the Zuihua Building. Sure enough, in the next second, twenty or thirty strong men walked out of the Zuihua Building with long black sticks in their hands. The strong man at the front saw Wu Tianhao grabbing the old madam's neck and shouted sharply: "Who are you? Let go of our boss! "
When Wu Tianhao heard what this man said, he wanted to crush the neck of the Madam of Zuihualou, but the next second a hand held down his wrist. Wu Tianhao was a little surprised and a little angry, but when he turned to look at the person beside him, all the anger in his heart disappeared.
"There is no need for this, Sect Master Wu! There are too many people here. If you kill this madam in front of so many people, I'm afraid it will leave a vicious image to ordinary people! Yang Xiu said slowly.
Upon hearing this, Wu Tianhao immediately let go of his hand, clasped his hands in a salute to Yang Xiu and said, "What Brother Yang said is that I was really too anxious just now! "
Yang Xiu waved his hand and looked at the Madam of Zuihualou. The Madam of Zuihualou, who had regained her life, was kneeling on the ground and covering her neck, breathing heavily. Yang Xiu was not anxious and just waited for her to adjust her breathing.
After about eight seconds, the Madam of Zuihualou recovered. She stood up from the ground tremblingly and looked at Yang Xiu. To her surprise, she just glanced at Yang Xiu, and fear from the depths of her soul welled up in her heart, as if the person standing in front of her was not a young man, but Yama from hell.
"Look at me! Tell me the money will come soon. Is it here? Yang Xiu had a harmless smile on his face, but the Madam of Zuihualou just glanced at her and lowered her head. She said in a trembling voice: "No...not here!" "
"Sincerely! "Yang Xiu said four words lightly, then he turned to look at the crowd behind him and said, "It might be a little loud later! You'd better cover your ears! "
Perhaps because of Wu Tianhao's attitude, the people behind him subconsciously covered their ears.
“Come on the money! I only give you a quarter of an hour to come out! Otherwise, I will demolish your Zuihua Building and dig deep to find you! "Yang Xiu used his spiritual power in these words. The reason why he was so sure that Qian Kuai Lai was here was because he felt the auras of Russell Yun and Karen Xia underground. The digging three feet just now was for Qian Kuai Lai and Karen Xia.
On the ground floor of Zuihua Building, Russell Yun and Karen Xia raised their heads at the same time when they heard Yang Xiu's words. Their eyes were full of light, while Qian Kuai Lai in front of them had livid faces, because what Yang Xiu just said about digging three feet into the ground, he was 100% sure that he was talking to him.
